primary_title: Image Recognition with Online Lightweight Vision Transformer: A Survey
official_code_url: https://github.com/ajxklo/Lightweight-VIT (paper project page; survey/supporting code, not a candidate model implementation)
resource_evidence: Survey; no one model's CPU timings or RAM established. ImageNet-1K comparison is the stated evidence.

primary_title: VisionWeave: Weaving Elastic Visual Representations as a Native Capability of MLLMs
official_code_url: https://github.com/FFY0/VisionWeave (candidate link; primary paper has no verified official repo link in examined abstract)
resource_evidence: Training scale explicitly >30,000 A100 GPU-hours; 4B and 27B MLLMs. Clearly not a CPU-small model.

primary_title: Squeez: Task-Conditioned Tool-Output Pruning for Coding Agents
resource_evidence: Qwen 3.5 2B LoRA fine-tune; no CPU latency/RAM in reviewed abstract. No evidence it removes the need for stored archive/retrieval; task is selective context input. Official README also offers a smaller extractive ModernBERT alternative; performance parity with 2B is not established.

primary_title: SWE-Pruner: Self-Adaptive Context Pruning for Coding Agents
resource_evidence: 0.6B skimmer; README says reuse/reproduction recommends at least 4 GPUs; HF code-pruner card available. The paper also includes CPU claims only indirectly; do not infer practical CPU speed from model size.

primary_title: DeepCode: Open Agentic Coding
resource_evidence: Agent framework requiring LLM and repo tool loop; no CPU budget or compact model claim. Paper/repo evaluations depend on external models and compute.

primary_title: EfficientLLM: Efficiency in Large Language Models
resource_evidence: Study run on 48 GH200 + 8 H200 GPUs; explicitly production-class cluster. Not a CPU-ready artifact or evidence of practical local model quality.

primary_title: GLiNER multi-task: Generalist Lightweight Model for Various Information Extraction Tasks
official_code_url: https://github.com/urchade/GLiNER (associated official framework; exact multi-task checkpoint/release needs pinning)
resource_evidence: Paper calls it a small encoder, but reviewed abstract supplies no parameter count/CPU timings. Prior GLiNER line has CPU evidence, but do not transfer those measurements automatically to this multitask variant.

primary_title: Return of the Encoder: Maximizing Parameter Efficiency for SLMs
resource_evidence: Official README reports 330M model CPU latency 1591ms, GPU 86ms, NPU 189ms; 1B-scale artifacts. Training requires torchrun/GPU and teacher checkpoint; CPU infer path provided. Paper says it isolates architecture under matched data/params/optimization.

primary_title: Designing Large Foundation Models for Efficient Training and Inference: A Survey
resource_evidence: No model artifact or CPU workload; survey only.

primary_title: Continually Post-training Small Models via Synthetic Self-distillation
resource_evidence: Unknown; do not infer CPU capability from title or HF metadata.

primary_title: The Other Half of the Memory Wall: Serving 35B MoEs from SSD with Trained Routing Prediction
resource_evidence: Primary abstract explicitly requires 19.5GB 4-bit weights for the 35B model and a 24GB machine. 3GiB is peak active memory, not full storage. Exceeds this run 2GB download cap; accelerator type unverified.

primary_title: Efficient Post-training Quantization with FP8 Formats
resource_evidence: FP8 generally requires supported accelerators; no evidence in reviewed source that it improves x86 CPU inference. Pool's vision classification match is irrelevant.

primary_title: GLiNER2: An Efficient Multi-Task Information Extraction System with Schema-Driven Interface
resource_evidence: Paper reports 205M parameters and CPU latencies 130–208ms across 5–50 labels, but does not fully specify general CPU hardware in table snippet. CPU baseline times include GPT-4o network/API 358–463ms and DeBERTa 1714–16897ms. Official README says CPU-first/no GPU required. No retraining required for initial schema test.

primary_title: Coding-Agent Benchmarks Should Match Their Users' Task Flows
official_code_url: https://github.com/JetBrains-Research/SWE-TaskFlow-Generation-Public (candidate official repo from primary paper/HF page; inspect before use)
resource_evidence: Benchmark/data analysis; no model/CPU inference claim. Pilot on 700 SWE-Bench Pro issues; cost and resolve rate are paper-reported.

primary_title: LSNet: See Large, Focus Small
official_code_url: https://github.com/THU-MIG/lsnet (official PyTorch code; paper also lists jameslahm/lsnet, likely mirror/author alias, pin canonical project)
resource_evidence: Official README says throughput tests used NVIDIA RTX3090, so the commonly shown throughput does not establish CPU performance. ImageNet-1K weights available.

primary_title: PP-LCNet: A Lightweight CPU Convolutional Neural Network
resource_evidence: Paper provides CPU-specific Intel Xeon Gold 6148 + MKLDNN latency and parameter counts. Figures are hardware/software-specific; not a current target CPU measurement.

primary_title: A Survey of Small Language Models
resource_evidence: No model or CPU timing; literature review only.

primary_title: An Empirical Study of Harness Design for Coding Agents
resource_evidence: Study uses 4 models, 176 settings, two coding benchmarks; compute/budget not established in accessible abstract. Findings are directly relevant to context management.

primary_title: GEB-1.3B: Open Lightweight Large Language Model
resource_evidence: 1.3B FP32 weights require at least ~5.2GB for weights alone (derived 1.3B×4 bytes; not total RAM); paper abstract gives no measured CPU timing and describes ongoing quantization work.

primary_title: LiteGUI: Lightweight GUI Agents via Multi-Solution Guided Distillation and Dual-Level Reinforcement Learning
resource_evidence: 2B/3B GUI agent models; RL/post-training and vision-language inference likely accelerator-intensive, but exact training/inference budget not available in abstract. Treat GPU need as unknown rather than false.
